Estra Stir is a gossip columnist for a newspaper in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.
“
'How' is such an overrated question. It's the who and the why that matter, darling.
„
— Estra Stir, answering how she knows the player character.

Involvement

Act Three

Estra Stir works for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette in the Lower City. If  Enver Gortash is alive, she informs the party they are the subject of the Gazette's next issue - the juiciest one to date. Estra refuses to elaborate and rejects any arguments about the party's consent to be written about. However, her statements initiate the quest ⁠Stop the Presses. The party can investigate Baldur's Mouth by speaking to the editor,  Ettvard Needle.

If Gortash is dead, Estra informs the party that they should read the Gazette to learn the real story behind his death. If ⁠Stop the Presses was not yet initiated, it is no longer possible to start the quest by speaking with Estra.

She is one of many citizens forcibly transformed into a Mind Flayer by the Netherbrain upon collecting all three Netherstones.

Idle banter

Estra can be found occassionally chatting to  News Hawker Luan:

  • News Hawker Luan
    Below the fold again Estra, I told you you should've added pictures!
  • Estra Stir
    Go on then, if you think you can do better - pitch me your story.
  • News Hawker Luan
    All right here's one for you - did you hear about the rabbit that became a frog?
  • Estra Stir
    Mmmhmm. Perhaps you just focus on the paper selling and leave the writing to me.
  • Estra Stir
    Go on then. Tell me a story that'd beat Gortash's death for the headline. (If Enver Gortash is killed)
